The '''Rafa Chabalrussa''' was a [[Casino/Legends|casino]] on [[Rafa V]]. In [[9 BBY/Legends|9 BBY]], [[Lando Calrissian/Legends|Lando Calrissian]] and [[Quaffug]] the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] participated in a high-stakes [[Sabacc/Legends|sabacc]] match in the Rafa Chabalrussa.
